events.title: Verizon Lifts FY26 Outlook After Higher Q3; Signs $2 Bln AI Deal With AWS; Stock Drops
events.description: Telecom major Verizon Communications Inc. on Monday reported higher third-quarter results and raised fiscal 2026 forecast. Further, the company announced that it has signed an agreement valued at more than $2.0 billion with Amazon Web Services or AWS to expand its AI Infrastructure. In the early morning trading on the NYSE, VZ shares were losing around 2.34 percent.

events.title: Canadian Market Likely To Open On Positive Note
events.description:
Higher precious metals prices and easing concerns about inflation thanks to a drop in oil prices suggest a positive start for stocks on Bay Street Monday morning. 

With a slew of corporate earnings updates from Canada and U.S. due this week, the mood in the market is likely to remain a bit cautious.

events.title: Dollar Index Edged Down Last Week
events.description: The U.S. Dollar retreated and the Dollar Index edged down during the week ended October 23 that witnessed renewed AI jitters and geopolitical tensions. Expectations of a monetary policy pause by the Federal Reserve kept the Dollar Index subdued. The debt-market-turmoil in Fance also weighed on currency market sentiment.

events.title: FTSE 100 Advances As Bank, Mining Stocks Climb Higher
events.description:
The U.K. stock market gained moderate ground in positive territory on Monday, supported by gains in bank, mining and technology stocks. 

Slightly easing concerns about inflation amid a notable drop in oil prices helped underpin sentiment.

events.title: German Business Confidence Rises For Sixth Month: Ifo
events.description: German business sentiment improved for the sixth straight month in October, underpinned by more optimistic expectations, monthly survey data from the ifo Institute showed Monday. The business sentiment index rose to 90.2 in October from 89.9 in the previous month, marking the highest score since May 2023.

events.title: NZ Dollar Rises Amid RBNZ Rate Hike Speculation
events.description: The New Zealand dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Monday, as traders expect that the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) will deliver a rate hike later this week.

events.title: French Equities Rise As Crude Slides On Middle East Diplomacy
events.description: French equities gained ground Monday as oil prices fell amid diplomatic efforts to reduce West Asia tensions. The CAC 40 index rose 0.7% while investors awaited monetary policy announcements from major central banks this week.

events.title: Indian Shares End Notably Higher As Oil Prices Retreat
events.description: Indian shares reversed course to end notably higher on Monday as investors closely monitored the situation in the Middle East and awaited an upcoming Federal Reserve interest-rate decision.

events.title: German Equities Rally On Oil Price Decline, Economic Optimism
events.description: German stocks gained as oil prices fell 1.5% on West Asia diplomatic efforts. Bayer led gainers with a 3.4% jump, while Germany's October business climate index reached its highest level since May 2023.

events.title: Gold Edges Higher As Oil Prices Retreat After Nearing Six-month Highs
events.description: Gold edged higher on Monday as investors closely monitored the situation in the Middle East and awaited an upcoming Federal Reserve interest-rate decision.

events.title: Oil Prices Retreat From Near Six-month Highs On Hopes For Diplomacy
events.description: Oil prices fell more than 2 percent on Monday after reports of diplomatic efforts to reduce regional tensions in West Asia.

events.title: European Shares Rise As Oil Prices Retreat From Near Six-month Highs
events.description: European stocks were modestly higher on Monday as easing oil prices provided some relief and investors looked forward to a slew of central bank meetings as well key tech earnings for directional cues.

events.title: NZ Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The New Zealand dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Monday.
